scope: Latorvius dependency implementation contract; not runtime support or independent certification. Historical rewards are generated dependencies, not legal deck additions.

primary_sources.supports: Printed ten-turn Quest; does not establish exact progress checkpoint.
Two random Journey to UnGoro Quest rewards to hand, remainder shuffled.
Extra turn and once-per-game restriction; matches frozen record.

rewards.name: Time Warp
rewards.implementation: Extra-turn scheduling after complete end-turn cleanup; once-per-game consumption per player.
rewards.validation: Replay, two controllers, skipped turns, death and turn-limit boundaries.

rewards.name: Crystal Core
rewards.implementation: Persistent player stat-setting rule for existing and future minions.
rewards.validation: Hand/deck/board scope, silence, transformation, control changes, damage and later enchantment ordering.

rewards.name: Barnabus
rewards.implementation: Snapshot deck minions and attach cost-setting changes to physical cards.
rewards.validation: Future shuffled cards excluded; draw/bounce and later cost modifiers.

rewards.name: Nether Portal
rewards.implementation: Permanent untouchable board entity with two end-turn Imp summons.
rewards.validation: Board capacity, target exclusion, copying, placement and trigger ordering.

rewards.name: Queen Carnassa
rewards.implementation: Shuffle twenty physical Brood tokens; Brood Battlecry draws.
rewards.validation: Deck caps, shuffle attribution, draw triggers; frozen Queen includes Rush.

rewards.name: Sulfuras
rewards.implementation: Battlecry replaces primary hero power with random enemy damage.
rewards.validation: Power refresh/cost, targeting, damage bonuses and replacement interactions.

rewards.name: Amara
rewards.implementation: Reuse hero Health-setting semantics after verifying maximum/current Health.
rewards.validation: Armor, damage history, healing triggers and health caps.

rewards.name: Megafin
rewards.implementation: Fill hand using complete random Murloc pool.
rewards.validation: Frozen generation eligibility, full hand, selection with replacement, entry triggers.

rewards.name: Galvadon
rewards.implementation: Five sequential Adapt offers on the same physical minion.
rewards.validation: Eligible adaptations, removed source, automatic choices and repeated Battlecries.

root_gates: Confirm whether survive progress increments at owner start/end or opponent end, including the turn Quest is played and extra/skipped turns.
Use exact nine-reward universe; draw two without replacement only after validating all outcomes.
Confirm overflow, reward order, shuffled remainder and repeated Battlecry behavior.

engine_attachment_points.extra_turn: expanded/lifecycle.py:_finish_turn after cleanup and before next owner selection; _begin_turn must still run all ordinary start work.
engine_attachment_points.adapt: expanded/adapt.py application helper; choice eligibility still needs resolution.
engine_attachment_points.generation: explicit complete PoolRequest contracts; never restrict to currently supported Murlocs.

acceptance: All nine reward bodies and their tokens/powers available before root admission.
Expose persistent player effects and remaining extra-turn state in observation/features.
Focused boundary fixtures plus consolidated regression on unchanged source.
Independent reference evidence required for unresolved timing and enchantment semantics.
